title: 법원 행정전자서명 인증업무에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:9:0:00009:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 9 (Preservation of Certification Records, etc.)
(1) The Certification Management Center shall securely retain and manage administrative digital-signature verification keys and certificates of subscribing agencies, etc., and records relating to certification services, and shall retain any certificate falling under any subparagraph of Article 6 for ten years from the date on which the relevant ground arose. <Amended on November 6, 2019>
(2) The Certification Management Center may transfer the administrative digital-signature verification keys and certificates retained under paragraph (1) to the Court Records Preservation Office after ten years of retention, so that they may continue to be preserved. <Amended on November 6, 2019>
(3) The Certification Management Center shall ensure that any person can verify through an information and communications network whether a certificate issued by the Director General of the National Court Administration falls under any subparagraph of Article 6.
